newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar extends gains ahead of Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar extends gains ahead of Hindu festival.

text.p: Sugar prices extended gains on the local market on Monday, dealers said.
"Increased consumer buying as well as higher demand from the retailers ahead of Diwali festival dragged prices upward while arrivals remained at low ebb," a deal said.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 rose 3/8 rupees to 1,308/1,333 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved up by 6/7 rupees to 1,332/1,376 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery rose 5 rupees to 1,235/1,245 rupees per quintal on outstation support.
"Offerings by mill owners were restricted as they expect higher prices in the coming days," one broker said.
